description.en:
Never get stuck in AI traffic again!
- AI traffic behaves just like in the base game: it stops and waits for you, and moving cars are solid. - Any traffic car that stands still near one of your vehicles for a couple of seconds becomes pass-through, so you can drive straight through it instead of getting jammed up. - The car turns solid again once it drives off and is clear of your vehicles. - Helpers (base game, AutoDrive and Courseplay) that are stopped by an obstruction for 2 seconds turn off collisions with it and continue on their course, driving forwards or reversing - whether it's an AI traffic car, a parked vehicle or your own vehicle. - Two helpers that bump into each other or block each other drive through each other after 2 seconds, even when only one of them can see the other. A helper waiting its turn with a gap, like trucks queueing at an unload point, is never pushed into. A helper that faces the other one or crosses its path, like an unloader waiting in the field, is driven through. - Collisions are turned back on as soon as the helper has cleared the obstruction. - Works for you and your helpers, in single player and multiplayer. - No settings needed - just activate the mod.
